records.text: Owens tentatively identified the black SUV as a Chevy Tahoe, correcting her initial Suburban identification; she described its occupant as tall and stockier, wearing athletic shorts and a short-sleeved shirt that looked light, maybe gray.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
